Titles.eng: Detective Conan: Captured in Her Eyes
Titles.jpn: 名探偵コナン 瞳の中の暗殺者

Summaries.eng: Police officers around Tokyo are being murdered by an unknown assailant. When Ran witnesses an attempt on the life of one of her friends in the police, she loses her memory. Now, Conan and Inspector Megure must find the murderer while Ran attempts to regain her lost memories.

Aliases: Case Closed: Captured in Her Eyes
